column3: Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” and “faithfulness” are rendered “mercy” and “truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; הַגּוֹיִם (“the nations”) is rendered “the Gentiles.”
Close to the Hebrew; “make a sound” is rendered “mutter.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will be like them” is rendered “are like them.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “us” after the first “He will bless.”
Close to the Hebrew; “may the LORD add to you” is rendered “May the LORD give you increase.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the heavens are the heavens of the LORD” is rendered “The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD’S.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Hallelujah” is rendered “Praise the LORD!”
